issues.summary: Structural limitations (records 14, 42) were treated as Tier-3 gaps instead of Tier-4 invariants
issues.resolution: Accepted. Added invariants I4 (per-octave staff periodicity; anticipated by schema.md's feasibility hooks) and I5 (absolute pitch anchoring; schema.md's offset-0=C convention) under the spec's confirm-or-amend instruction; re-tiered record 14 to Tier 4 (I4) and record 42 to Tier 4 (I5); updated counts (21/12/1/21), Tier-4 partition, feed-forward lists, E1/E2 driver tables (42 moved to Tier-4 evidence), and the uncataloged-gaps list.

issues.summary: Tier 3 was redefined beyond the spec ('devices or display behaviors')
issues.resolution: Accepted (verifier's offered alternative adopted). Tier 3's primary wording restored to the spec verbatim; the single remaining extension (record 7's partial-display case) is now an explicitly documented amendment in the tier definition, dated to this verification round.

issues.summary: Recorded UAT attestation did not clearly attest the final corrected deliverables
issues.resolution: Accepted. The initial attestation is now marked preliminary/superseded in s2-uat.md, and a post-correction attestation was obtained from the operator over the final corrected verdicts (verbatim: 'Attested — corrected records and tier verdicts stand as final'), recorded in the s2-uat.md addendum.

issues.summary: Invariant selection was justified by prevalence rather than architecture
issues.resolution: Accepted. Matrix §1 now states an explicit architectural invariant test (structural output difference vs omitted redundant marks, prevalence irrelevant); both amendments and the record-7 non-elevation are argued from that test.
